sloka: समुत्पतति तस्मिंस्तु वेगात्ते नगरोहिणः ।संहृत्य विटपान् सर्वान् समुत्पेतुः समन्ततः ॥५-१-४५॥
transliteration: samutpatati tasmiṁstu vegātte nagarohiṇaḥ ।saṁhṛtya viṭapān sarvān samutpetuḥ samantataḥ ॥5-1-45॥

translations.english: When he took off, numerous trees on the mountain drawing together the branches all over flew along with him.
